name: custom4-pcie-h100-cal
description: Calibrated 4x H100 PCIe node fabric for TP4 (hardware validation 2026-09-26): ring-only PCIe graph (the NVLink bridge cannot serve a ring), 17.3 GiB/s per direction (measured NCCL plateau), 300 ns effective per-hop latency and a 24 us collective launch floor (both read off nccl-tests at 8 B), persistent channels (-preconnected), receiver-side completion (--recv-flow-finish), 4 MiB dataset splits up to 16. Against nccl-tests on htc-g055: all-reduce within -12..+10 % at <= 64 KiB and >= 4 MiB, 14-25 % fast at 256 KiB-1 MiB (NCCL protocol regime), all-gather/reduce-scatter 5-9 % fast at large sizes, all-to-all 10-17 % fast.
